Independent face and F2 rank verification agrees.

value.rationale: The finite-plane nonincidence graph and the nonblocking-set simplicial complex are canonical natural objects. Determining the precise 39/1 mixed-dimensional sphere wedge for each component and verifying a null integral top attaching map goes substantially beyond general connectivity/π1 or face-table computations. The finite exact case is a useful benchmark without an asserted all-order theorem.
